d:
This time in the ‘Guest In The Newsroom’, our guest is Actress Tamannaah Bhatia, a superstar in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi cinema. Starting her career with Chand Sa Roshan Chehra, Tamannaah went on to star in blockbusters like Baahubali. In this episode, she opens up about her personal and professional journey, while also sharing her insights on the evolving status of women in the film industry.
Production: Akash Singh
Video Editor: Shakir Khan
